name: Strider
author: Erin Carter
description: Five water striders skate across still black water, each a tight cluster of four bright dimple-lenses trailing a faint diverging V-wake crossed by fine ripple striations. Per-strider palette colours bleed into the wakes; motion is stroke-and-coast, the dimples flaring at each skating pulse.

params.label: Glide speed
params.effect: Scales the stroke-and-coast travel rate of every strider; at 0 they hover with only faint residual ripples.

params.label: Wake length
params.effect: CSS-pixel distance the V-wake arms and striations persist astern before fading to black.

params.label: Dimple size
params.effect: Radius of each foot's bright dimple-lens and its dark refractive rim.
